=== JUNCTION ESTABLISHED (full (p, phi) check) ===
1. The p-boxes overlap (not only the phi-boxes):
   p-overlap = [1.30988253900099999999999999999999999999999999999999981364579, 1.31034037940100000000000000000000000000000000000000146500871].
2. On this p-overlap, combined with the hull of the two phi-boxes,
   C_pphi has strictly constant sign: for every p in the overlap,
   Cp(p, .) = 0 has at most one root phi in the hull. Each side's own
   existence certificate (Hohmann: Ghat_a = t*Cpp > 0 on the last
   tile; central: interval-Newton enclosure on the fresh tile) keeps
   its own root inside its own phi-box, itself contained in the
   hull. Since the hull admits at most one root for each p in the
   overlap, the two roots coincide: the Hohmann bridge and the
   central mesh describe the same physical (p, phi) stationary point.
